notes: Round 2 saturation review accepts Jennifer round 1 topology exactly: all Diego round 1 asserted edges retained and the two voltage-signal-to-RPS-panel edges included.
VOLTAGE-SIG-A and VOLTAGE-SIG-B are treated as logical signal nodes; their asserted panel edges are instrument_signal and included in the matrix.
Dashed crossings at DC-BUS-21A and DC-BUS-21B are rejected as non-connections where no junction dot is present.
Matrix includes asserted_edges only; uncertain_edges are excluded.
